about: Misprints (PrintRules, docs/dev/unity-port.md section 8.5): every hero a summon gives comes as a numbered print of that banner's edition. A few come out misprinted (a flaw), some carry a holo foil, every one has a grade. Cosmetic only: prints never change stats and never fade. Editions: a banner's edition is the period of `days` days it falls in (from banner.json's epoch_day); other collectors take `per_hour` prints every hour after the edition opens, so pulling early gets low serials. A print run holds `run` prints; past that, the next printing starts again at No. 1.

flaws.name: Off register
flaws.about: The signal plate landed off its marks, so the red sits beside the ink.

flaws.name: Wrong ink
flaws.about: The press was loaded with the wrong colour for the second plate.

flaws.name: Missing plate
flaws.about: One plate never touched the paper: ink only, no signal red.

flaws.name: Double hit
flaws.about: The key plate struck twice, a hair apart.

flaws.name: Ink flood
flaws.about: Far too much ink: the shadows pooled and spread.
